description: This Java source file defines the CommonEvents class, which provides a collection of utility and event-handling methods for the OFBiz framework, such as updating user session preferences, generating CAPTCHA images, handling JSON/JavaScript responses, JWT token generation, and source file browsing.

classes.name: CommonEvents
classes.description: A utility class providing static event handlers for user preferences, security, captcha generation, JSON/JS responses, JWT tokens, and source code viewing within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: setSessionLocale
methods.description: Sets the user's session locale based on 'newLocale' request parameter and updates the user login record.

methods.name: setSessionTimeZone
methods.description: Sets the user's session time zone based on 'tzId' request parameter and updates the user login record.

methods.name: setSessionTheme
methods.description: Sets the user's visual theme based on 'userPrefValue' request parameter.

methods.name: setSessionCurrencyUom
methods.description: Sets the user's session currency unit of measure based on 'currencyUom' request parameter and updates the user login record.

methods.name: jsResponseFromRequest
methods.description: Retrieves a JavaScript snippet specified by 'name' parameter from cache and writes it to the response.

methods.name: jsonResponseFromRequestAttributes
methods.description: Builds JSON response from request attributes excluding ignored attributes and writes to the response.

methods.name: writeJSONtoResponse
methods.description: Helper method to write a JSON object as a response with appropriate headers.

methods.name: getCaptcha
methods.description: Generates a CAPTCHA image, stores the code in user session, and sends the image in the response.

methods.name: loadJWT
methods.description: Generates a JWT token for authenticated user session and sends the token as JSON.

methods.name: openSourceFile
methods.description: Opens and executes a command to display the source code of a component file, optionally at a specific line.
